<thought>Based on the molecular formula C7H14O5 and DBE = 1, a plausible structure is a seven‑carbon chain with a terminal carboxylic acid and three hydroxyl groups, e.g., HO‑CH2‑CH(OH)‑CH(OH)‑CH2‑CH2‑CH2‑COOH. Its SMILES representation is “OCC(O)C(O)CCC(=O)O”. This matches the required formula and DBE.</thought>
<final_answer>OCC(O)C(O)CCC(=O)O</final_answer>
